items.body:
# Situation

In relibc we need a way to have a static with the signature of
```
#[no_mangle]
pub static stdin: *mut FILE
```
Currently we have two statics, one for the file and one for the pointer.
However, using `unsafe { &mut default_stdin } as *mut _` doesn't work because
```
error[E0017]: references in statics may only refer to immutable values
  --> src/stdio/src/default.rs:68:36
   |
68 | pub static mut stdout: *mut FILE = unsafe { &mut default_stdout } as *mut _;
   |                                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ statics require immutable values
```

We were thinking of solving this with `UnsafeCell`, but it's not Sync and can't be used in a static, and the `get` function is not const fn.

```
error[E0277]: the trait bound `core::cell::UnsafeCell<FILE>: core::marker::Sync` is not satisfied
  --> src/stdio/src/default.rs:10:1
   |
10 | / static default_stdin: UnsafeCell<FILE> = UnsafeCell::new(FILE {
11 | |     flags: constants::F_PERM | constants::F_NOWR | constants::F_BADJ,
12 | |     rpos: ptr::null_mut(),
13 | |     rend: ptr::null_mut(),
...  |
22 | |     lock: AtomicBool::new(false),
23 | | });
   | |___^ `core::cell::UnsafeCell<FILE>` cannot be shared between threads safely
   |
   = help: the trait `core::marker::Sync` is not implemented for `core::cell::UnsafeCell<FILE>`
   = note: shared static variables must have a type that implements `Sync`

error[E0015]: calls in statics are limited to constant functions, struct and enum contructors
  --> src/stdio/src/default.rs:65:35
   |
65 | pub static mut stdin: *mut FILE = default_stdin.get();
   |                                   ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
```

The only way we see of doing this is with `unsafe { &default_stdin } as *const _ as *mut _`, as you can see [here](https://gitlab.redox-os.org/redox-os/relibc/blob/c24d1e2b361eae5227d2294d98e45d0658374785/src/stdio/src/default.rs#L68), however, that's undefined behavior according to the [nomicon](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nomicon/transmutes.html).

# Proposition

We can work around the Sync problem with a wrapper, but we need `get` to be const fn.
